pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Cool-season:$() sow as soon as the ground thaws. Sprouts after 130 °C·d above 0 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)1700 °C·d$(). Best near 18 °C; stops above 30 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -15 °C (-4 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 6-7.5 (tolerates 5.5-8). Roots 0.4 m. Dislikes waterlogging.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 120, P 22, K 110 kg/ha per crop.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 89 cwt/ac (10 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Garlic.
